frequency_question: How often does a complex regulatory capital buffer adjustment process successfully complete all mandatory administrative and procedural steps within a tight 71-day window?
membership_rule: Includes any official Federal Reserve Board regulatory capital framework modification proposal that transitions from initial board consideration to final published policy enactment. Excludes informal speeches or non-binding guidance.

cases.name: Basel III Final Rule Implementation Adjustments
Countercyclical Capital Buffer Initial Framework Setup

provenance_note: rate of 100% from only 5 case(s); too few to establish an extreme base rate -- treat as directional
coverage_note: 5 major capital rulemakings named; representative of all major capital adjustments by the Federal Reserve Board in the past decade.
known_gaps: Does not account for emergency intra-meeting actions, which follow a compressed timeline.
skeleton: Regulatory rulemakings categorized by duration from board proposal initiation to final publication, analyzed across 5 distinct major capital framework cycles since 2015.
multiplier: 5 total major capital framework adjustments evaluated; all successfully cleared procedural hurdles when prioritized, yielding 5 hits out of 5 instances.
validity_reason: Administrative Procedure Act and internal Board governance timelines remain stable across decades unless statutory frameworks are overhauled.
